name: 95363 · Patterson, CA
findings: ZIP 95363 (Patterson) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95363 (Patterson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
